A three-car garage provides additional space and convenience.    Despite its secluded setting, the property offers convenient access to Tifton and I-75. With approximately 7,400 square feet, 41 acres, a pond, pool, and truly distinctive architecture, this is a rare opportunity to own a private South Georgia estate.
